Everyone rides the cable car, ropeway and boat to reach Lake Ashi. From Gora there's also a bus: two short rides, 20 to 30 minutes, ¥910 to Moto-Hakone, and the Freepass covers it 👇

🤔 Guess which is quicker from Gora to Togendai: the bus, or the cable car plus ropeway? 👉 https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

We took our time with this one and checked every route, fare and timetable on Odakyu's own Hakone Navi pages.

🚡 A · THE ROPEWAY LOOP

Cable car to Sounzan, then about 30 minutes in the gondola over Owakudani's steam vents to Togendai (¥2,000 one way, included in the Freepass), then the boat across the lake. This is the view people come to Hakone for.

🚌 B · THE BUS

The "S" bus from Gora to Kowakien, then the H line to Moto-Hakone. You step off a short walk from Hakone Shrine's lakeside torii. From Hakone-Yumoto there's a direct bus too, about 30 minutes.

🔁 C · MIX THEM

Views out, bus back. Ropeway and boat in the morning, then the bus home from Moto-Hakone, so you never sit through the slow loop twice.

💭 OUR TAKE

First visit with a Freepass? Do C. Windy or misty day, or you've done the ropeway before? Bus both ways, and spend the saved hour in an onsen.

👉 The refund most Freepass holders forget to ask for, plus our half-day route and lunch by the lake:
